description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl Detect brings Cribl’s telemetry platform and security expertise together to help customers improve detection coverage, reduce alert noise, and speed investigations—while keeping the flexibility to use the tools they already have. As Director of Security Research, you’ll build and lead a research organization across detection engineering, threat hunting, and AI-driven triage and investigation. You’ll develop the team, set research priorities, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape Cribl Detect. You’ll also publish technical research and collaborate with Cribl’s internal SOC to strengthen Cribl’s defenses.

Based in Israel, this hybrid role works closely with teammates across Israel and the US, with regular overlap with US working hours and periodic travel to the US. The package includes competitive compensation and equity, pension and Keren Hishtalmut contributions subject to local policy, paid time off, a Cibus meal card, and professional development.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Build and lead the research organization: hire and develop researchers and research leaders, set shared standards, and align priorities with customer needs, emerging threats, and product goals.
  • Own threat-informed detection content and effectiveness by turning threat intelligence into validated rules and hunt packs, maintaining coverage, fidelity, telemetry readiness, and rule health, and delivering timely threat advisories.
  • Guide AI-driven investigations by defining how agents test hypotheses, gather evidence, distinguish malicious from legitimate activity, and escalate uncertainty; partner with Engineering to evaluate accuracy, completeness, and false-negative risk.
  • Lead telemetry and security-tool research: define evidence needs and tool capabilities, study how telemetry collection and transformation affect security outcomes, and guide data requirements and integrations.
  • Shape security methods and evaluation for additional AI-agent workflows, including MITRE mapping, noise tuning, and rule authoring.
  • Build technical credibility through substantive publications, practitioner guides, presentations, and selected public tools, frameworks, or datasets.
  • Partner with Cribl’s internal SOC on detections, threat hunts, investigation methods, and security validation; use operational feedback to improve research and product quality while respecting the SOC’s operational ownership.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • 10+ years in security research, detection engineering, threat hunting, or investigation, including 5+ years leading teams and a record of turning research into customer-facing content or product capabilities.
  • Experience hiring and developing researchers, growing technical leaders, and building collaborative teams.
  • Strong understanding of adversary behavior, MITRE ATT&CK, security telemetry, detection validation, and analyst workflows.
  • Experience guiding AI agents across security workflows and evaluating output accuracy, security effectiveness, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Practical knowledge of security tools, APIs, and data limitations, with the ability to review detection logic and investigative methods and validate ideas through queries, scripting, or prototypes.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, including the ability to prioritize research and influence Product, Engineering, customers, and executives.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, including to the US.
  • Bonus: Experience spanning detection engineering and automated investigation, or developing investigative guidance or evaluation datasets for AI agents.
  • Bonus: Experience with cloud attack paths, identity, workload security, or cloud-native telemetry; substantive publications, conference presentations, or open-source security contributions are also valued.
  • Bonus: An open, low-ego communication style and an appreciation for good—or bad—jokes.

Bring Your Whole Self

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us.
